review_scope: CUDA/VMM main, data ordering, buffer lifetimes; sampler reviewed independently by other agent
facts: Four allocations remain live until all four comparisons are complete.
Send allocations are accessible only by their owner; receive allocations are shared RW; source GPU executes both SM and CUDA copy requests.
Both source and poisoned destination are initialized by owner, synchronized and compared fully before sampling.
Active transfer window has no H2D/D2H payload operations, PCI snapshots or normal logging; one batch has at most 64 x 1 MiB logical payload operations.
CUDA event completion precedes active_end; sampler stops and joins before owner D2H comparison.
Volatile remote stores preserve 64 repeated SM passes; fence executes on threads that wrote.
Device identity, current context, stream context and VMM permissions are verified.
Four comparisons: two directions by SM and CUDA_COPY_REQUEST; copies are not called CE-observed.
limits: NVML counters aggregate all PCIe traffic; they cannot prove direct routing by themselves.
submitted_payload_bytes is logical traffic requested, not measured bytes on wire.
Host API calls may block; native wrapper and watchdog remain necessary.
No GPU execution or NVCC compilation performed by this review.
